items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ed Strait. He was like Roy Knapp in Chicago. I took a few lessons from him too.

ctx.x: Ed Strait. He was like Roy Knapp in Chicago. I took a few lessons from him too. He was sharp. Older guy. He wrote these little books with a lot of material, great material, in them. Not so much with a set of drums, but playing the instrument as – per se.
We were looking in your stack of books there, and we came across Stick Control. George Lawrence Stone.
